---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a model, dataset, metric, or capability
title: "[feat] "
labels: enhancement
---

**What and why**
The capability you want and the problem it solves (e.g. a new dataset loader, a
preprocessing method, an uncertainty/OOD metric).

**Prior art**
Paper, repo, or method this is based on, if any.

**Scope**
Roughly where it fits (`src/raman_ml/` module, a `scripts/` runner, a benchmark)
and whether it needs a new dataset.
